name: EPF / UAN Services (Employees' Provident Fund)
description: Mandatory provident fund, pension (EPS), and insurance (EDLI) for organised-sector employees; managed via UAN.
eligibility: Employees with basic wage up to statutory limit in establishments covered under EPF Act.
benefits: Retirement corpus with interest, pension, withdrawal/advance facilities, transfer on job change.
application_steps: Activate UAN on EPFO member portal / UMANG.
Seed Aadhaar, bank, PAN via KYC.
Track claim status; amount credited to bank.
fees: No fee; statutory contributions by employer/employee.
office_locator_info: Regional EPFO offices; locate via portal.

faq.q: How do I check my PF balance?
faq.a: Via UMANG app, EPFO missed call 9966044425, or member portal.

ai_summary: EPFO manages EPF/EPS/EDLI for organised employees via UAN; online claims and transfers.
ai_explanation: Employees contribute to EPF with employer matching; the UAN ties multiple member IDs across jobs. Members can seed KYC and file online claims for withdrawal, transfer, or advances. Balance and status are checkable via UMANG or the member portal.
common_questions: How do I check PF balance?
How do I transfer PF on job change?
common_mistakes: Not seeding Aadhaar/PAN causing claim rejection
